breakthroughs.technique: Eliminated 240MB orders_custkey pre-build exceeding LLC. Replaced with chained sequential lookups through index + raw column.
Replaced unordered_map group assignment with composite key direct array mapping (~60KB L1-resident). Per-group small-sort for COUNT(DISTINCT) instead of global sort.
Replaced 256MB thread-local hash maps with thread-local collect vectors + single 4MB global hash map.
Capped threads from 64 to 16 so thread-local arrays (12.8MB) fit in 44MB LLC. calloc inside parallel for NUMA first-touch.
